Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, co As Object, co2 As Object, ca As Object, pa As Object
    Dim cos As Object, s As String
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet): Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    ws.Range("A1:A4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("k", "a", "b", "c"))
    ws.Range("B1:B4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("v", 1, 2, 3))
    ws.Range("B2").Select
    Set co = ws.ChartObjects.Add(150, 10, 200, 120): co.Chart.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:B4")
    co.Chart.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
    Set co2 = ws.ChartObjects.Add(150, 150, 200, 120): co2.Chart.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:B4")
    Set ca = co.Chart.ChartArea: Set pa = co.Chart.PlotArea: Set cos = ws.ChartObjects
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
    Case 1
        co.Activate: ca.Select
    Case 2
        ca.Select
    Case 3
        co.Activate: pa.Select
    Case 4
        pa.Select
    Case 5
        co.Width = 300: co.Height = 150
    Case 6
        co.RoundedCorners = True: co.Shadow = True
    Case 7
        co.Activate: co.Chart.ChartType = xlLine
    Case 8
        co.Activate: co.Chart.HasTitle = True
    Case 9
        cos.Select
    Case 10
        cos.Select: ws.Range("A1").Select
    Case 11
        co.Activate: ca.Select: pa.Select
    Case 12
        co.Activate: pa.Select: ws.Range("C3").Select
    Case 13
        co.Activate: ca.Select: co2.Activate
    Case 14
        co.Chart.HasLegend = False
    Case 15
        co.Left = 0.3: co.Top = 0.6: co.Width = 100.4: co.Height = 50.2
    End Select
    On Error Resume Next
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & TypeName(Selection)
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & TypeName(ActiveChart)
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & ca.Name
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & TypeName(ca.Parent)
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & TypeName(ca.Application)
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & ca.Left
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & ca.Top
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & ca.Width
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & ca.Height
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & ca.Shadow
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & ca.RoundedCorners
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & pa.Name
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & TypeName(pa.Parent)
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & pa.Position
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & TypeName(pa.Application)
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & TypeName(cos.Application)
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & TypeName(cos.Parent)
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & TypeName(cos.ShapeRange)
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & cos.ShapeRange.Count
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & cos.ProtectChartObject
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & co.Width
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & co.Height
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    On Error GoTo 0
    Tried = "ok " & Mid(s, 2)
Closed:
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number
    Resume Closed
End Function

Public Function Probe() As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    For i = 0 To 15
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i)
    Next
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
